status: exploratory specification fixed before the new fits
cohort: primary40: preserve P011/P033 exclusion and original full-session catch-quality gate
eligibility: Original finite, responded AT/Baseline hits; no new fixed RT window
cleaning: Within each analysis/training subset, recompute original participant-wide mean +/-2.5 sample SD, inclusive. Then apply one additional pass of mean +/-2.5 sample SD within participant x condition x phase x SOA x trial type. Singleton/zero-SD groups are retained and flagged. No iterative trimming, visual cutoff tuning or selection by results.
trial_count: Full six blocks per intervention versus blocks 1-3 of EACH intervention. Recompute both trimming stages on the chosen subset. This is a fixed sensitivity, not a claim that later trials are invalid.
smoothing: Four overlapping adjacent-distance means of the five physical-distance means. H[j,j]=H[j,j+1]=.5. Means AND model predictions are transformed by H. Sampling covariance is sigma_AT^2 H diag(1/n) H^T, with shared baseline uncertainty integrated separately. Within-distance SSE remains in the scale likelihood. Missing windows are omitted; no interpolation or duplicated independent observations.
fits: Eight joint Bayesian fits: full/early x raw/rolling x broad-directional/visible95 geometry. Reuse original positive-amplitude nuisance priors and paired shape hierarchies; visible95 is an imposed in-range S, not new curvature evidence.
priors: Broad midpoint=(10+90*eta) cm, eta hierarchy fixed N([.5,0,0,0],.5), SD HalfNormal(.35); log(width/90) hierarchy fixed N([log(1/6),0,0,0],.7), SD HalfNormal(.5). Visible95 position/width logit hierarchies fixed N(0,1.5), SD HalfNormal(1), previous 2 cm floor and 5/95 endpoint support. Nuisance seconds: baseline N(.6,.4), corrected intercept N(0,.2), amplitude HalfNormal(.15), participant AT/Baseline SD LogNormal(log(.12),.5).
contrasts: For boundary and normalized sharpness export Condition=Viscereality-Control, Phase=Inhale-Exhale and their difference of phase differences, plus all established simple contrasts. Main effects are finite-cohort average participant contrasts. Export response contrasts separately. No tests treating pooled medians as independent measurements.
sampling: Four nutpie chains, 2000 tuning/2000 draws at target .99. One diagnostic-only extension to 4000/4000. Require zero divergences, rank Rhat<=1.01 and bulk/tail ESS>=400 across full model. Retain every attempt/failure; no extension or choice by effect direction.
validation: Fifteen full-session broad-model held-distance fits: original global-only raw, added-local raw and added-local rolling x five held distances. Exclude all held-distance AT outcomes before learning BOTH cutoff stages or smoothing. Retain independent Baseline calibration. Score identical ALL initially eligible held-out hits, without learning cutoffs from test RTs. Four chains 1000/1000, once 3000 draws/2000 tuning if needed. Predictive gate Rhat<=1.01, bulk/tail ESS>=400 and zero divergences; retain failures. Do not compare these targets numerically with older already-trimmed CV targets.
diagnostics: All eligible raw trials, every standardized deviation, existing/new exclusions, per-distance violin/scatter distributions, means/SD/counts; all 42 audit participants identified as included/excluded. Fatigue checks use recorded block/trial metadata, RT trends adjusted for distance, early-late error rates and variability, with participant as independent unit. No automatic fatigue exclusions.
fit_quality: Report trial-level, five-mean and four-rolling-mean R2 separately at the posterior expected AT response. R2>=.5 is descriptive; smoothing or four-parameter fitting to a few averages is not validation. Original trial-level .7 gate is preserved as historical evidence.
limits: SD-trimmed likelihoods condition on retained data and do not model the full selection process. Local estimates are unstable with small n; internally computed sample-SD z scores cannot exceed 2.5 with n<=8. Five distances limit shape information. Cross-validation is within cohort and retains independent Baseline. No new questionnaire, mediation, full repeated Bayesian coverage study, physiological validation, browser integration or manuscript rewrite is claimed.
stopping: Complete the declared variants and finite diagnostic extensions regardless of findings. Keep existing inputs/results byte-for-byte. Report model-dependent or inconclusive effects as such; no additional search triggered by failure to find an effect.
